title: Family medicine and preventive care
audience: a medical student in the clinical years preparing for the USMLE
purpose: Deliver preventive care and screening, adult immunizations, chronic care of hypertension, diabetes, lipids and obesity, common acute and musculoskeletal complaints, women's and men's health, care of older adults and polypharmacy, mental health in primary care, and population health.
primary_reading: U.S. Preventive Services Task Force recommendations

weeks.8: Musculoskeletal and back pain in primary care

blocks.deliverable: Write a screening plan for patients of three ages.
Titrate treatment to target in supplied cases.
Estimate cardiovascular risk and choose statin intensity.
Week 7 midterm; manage acute low back pain without red flags.
Deprescribe safely for an older patient.
Use a screening questionnaire for depression.
Submit the project; take an unseen 180 minute final in week 14.

project: Preventive care plan: for three supplied patients of different ages and risks, write an evidence-based screening and immunization plan.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
